items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Before a tape runs out, what were some of the other tunes Buddy Bowling played? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I couldn't think of all of them because it didn't have no name, you know? It didn't have no name.

ctx.x: Well he must be Dave Ernest. Dave was a good drummer too, Dave was. He had to be good because he had to really, he changed him up if he wasn't good. That is, you have to keep that rhythm, you can't increase, you don't want no drummer going to increase, you don't want no drummer going to lag. You got to be right on the beat, you know? Like that, you play more easy, it's more easy on everybody. You get some drummers, they, they kind of lag just a section or a fraction of you, just keep, they drag you back, you see?…
Before a tape runs out, what were some of the other tunes Buddy Bowling played?
Well, I couldn't think of all of them because it didn't have no name, you know? It didn't have no name.
